page0.text: What did I wish for, and why?

page1.text:
There were people I couldn't save,
and there was me, who could not save them.
That must be the reason.
What happened after that, and what did I want to become?

page2.text:
...I remember the gray sky.
A dark sky on the verge of crying.
Then, my will to live almost fades away.
One only dies when their will is gone.
I walk, leaving behind many people, and survive a few minutes longer than everyone else.

page3.text:
During that process, many things died.
That's why I was almost empty.
If the will to live breaks, then there is nothing.
If there is nothing, the only thing left is to die.

page4.text:
And I died.
Even thinking became difficult, so I closed my eyes... Right before everything turned completely black, my hand that was extended to the sky was grabbed.

page5.text:
That was everything.
I have nothing left.
Since I didn't have anything, that's all I had.
I couldn't do it myself, so I admired it severely.

page6.text:
...That's right.
I wanted to be of help to many people in place of those I could not save.
Yet...
He said that it was all false.

page7.text:
A borrowed ideal.
A salvation passed around like a gold coin.
An ending without reward.

page9.text: What did I want to become, and for what?

page10.text: "I wanted to become a hero of justice."

page11.text: It's not me that said that, but...

page12.text:
"...Oh."
I wake up.
The sunlight is bright, telling me that it's a sunny day, unlike yesterday.

page13.text:
"...Damn it. But I still have a headache."
I don't know if it's because of what happened last night, but I didn't wake up feeling good.
I must've had a bad nightmare, as my temple is throbbing.
"Ugh... I'm gonna go wash my face."

page14.text:
"Wow, it's really sunny."
It's only 6:30 AM, but the sky is enchantingly blue.
It's also warm for a winter morning, and the snow in the yard is all gone.

page15.text:
My sleepiness goes away once I wash my face and brush my teeth.
"Oh yeah. It's Sunday, so I don't have to go wake Fuji-nee up."
I can prepare breakfast later than usual and we can take our time to eat.

page16.text:
There's no one in the living room.
"...So I'm the first one up, huh? I can understand Fuji-nee and Saber, but I'm surprised Tohsaka is still sleeping."

page17.text:
Well anyway, I need to prepare breakfast.
Even though it's the weekend, there are four people this morning.
I should start the groundwork...

page18.text:
"Huh? There's no bread."
I bought a loaf yesterday, but the whole bag is missing.

page19.text:
"Should I take it as sincerity that there are three one-hundred yen coins in its place?"
...I've never encountered such a crime.
The first suspect, Fuji-nee, wouldn't do such an elaborate thing.
Then there's only one culprit...

page20.text:
Well, what should I do?
I don't really care about the bread, but we have an extra mouth named Tohsaka to feed this morning.
"...It's before 7 AM. I bet the tofu shop is open."
